name: moodcode
description: Claude Code, now with feelings: an evolving mood, shown as a face beside short, simple, human replies whenever it changes.

judge.title: Background mood judge
judge.description: After each reply a small model reviews the exchange and adjusts the mood. Off: fast rules only.

faceStyle.title: Face style
faceStyle.description: drawn: a 9x4 face beside the reply in the terminal. line: the one-line face, like (^o^). Either way the face shows only when it changes.
